# ClaUi

> VS Code extension (Marketplace id JhonBar.claude-code-mirror, installed as ~/.vscode/extensions/jhonbar.claude-code-mirror-<version>) that gives Claude Code and Codex a multi-tab chat UI. It ships its own MCP server, a CLI and Node.js / Python client libraries so AI agents can control it: open chat tabs, send prompts and read the replies, answer approvals, change models and settings, search history, follow UI events. Nothing has to be turned on; VS Code with ClaUi must be running.

## Connect an AI agent to ClaUi

- [AI agent integration guide](Kingdom_of_Claudes_Beloved_MDs/AI_AGENT_INTEGRATION.md): Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Windsurf, VS Code agents and custom code; all 47 tools; window selection; settings; troubleshooting
- Machine-specific guide written when VS Code starts: ~/.claui/remote-control/CONNECT.md (machine-readable: ~/.claui/remote-control/connection.json)
- Claude Code, one command: `node ~/.claui/remote-control/bin/claui.js register` (Windows PowerShell: `node "$env:USERPROFILE\.claui\remote-control\bin\claui.js" register`), then start a new Claude Code session
- Codex / Cursor / Claude Desktop / Windsurf / any MCP client: `node ~/.claui/remote-control/bin/claui.js mcp-config --client <codex|cursor|claude-desktop|windsurf|generic>` prints the config to paste
- Agents inside VS Code: nothing to do, ClaUi registers its MCP server with VS Code
- Check the connection: `node ~/.claui/remote-control/bin/claui.js doctor`
